mapper.select: SELECT g.*, u.username as seller_name, c.category_name as category_name FROM second_hand_mall g LEFT JOIN sellers s ON g.seller_id = s.seller_id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON g.category_id = c.category_id WHERE g.second_hand_mall_id = #{goodsId}
SELECT FROM second_hand_mall ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO second_hand_mall ( seller_id, category_id, title, description, content, price, price_ago, inventory, status, cover_img, img_1, img_2, img_3, img_4, img_5, remarks, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sellerId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{content}, #{price}, #{priceAgo}, #{inventory}, #{status}, #{coverImg}, #{img1}, #{img2}, #{img3}, #{img4}, #{img5}, #{remarks}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM second_hand_mall WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT g.*, u.username as seller_name FROM second_hand_mall g LEFT JOIN sellers s ON g.seller_id = s.seller_id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.status = 1 ORDER BY g.recommend DESC, g.hits DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.seller_id AS sellerId, g.cover_img AS coverImg FROM second_hand_mall g INNER JOIN ( SELECT seller_id, MIN(second_hand_mall_id) AS min_id FROM second_hand_mall WHERE status = 1 AND cover_img IS NOT NULL AND cover_img <> '' GROUP BY seller_id ) t ON g.second_hand_mall_id = t.min_id WHERE g.seller_id IN #{id}
